questions.prompt: Which observation best identifies diffraction at a gap?

options.A: The wave stops at the barrier
options.B: The wavefronts spread into directions outside the straight-through region
options.C: The frequency increases after the gap
options.D: Fixed nodes appear before the gap

options.A: Sound waves spread around the doorway edge
options.B: Sound particles travel from the source to the listener
options.C: The doorway increases the sound frequency
options.D: A stationary sound wave must form
